scope: Personal per-SIM roaming feature; no new upstream code cherry-picked in this release.
personal_changes: Bind an ordered manual LTE PLMN allowlist to the live ICCID and Worker generation.
Correct an already-camped disallowed network; never fall back to automatic selection.
Wait 90 seconds per target; use the next target after failures; back off five minutes after exhaustion.
Keep a working fallback and prefer the first target again on sustained loss or reconstruction.
Hot reload a private local-only configuration; retain last valid policy on invalid or missing reload.
Cancel generic registration recovery while the SIM policy owns selection; preserve flight/VoWiFi and data preconditions.
Avoid persisting per-SIM targets into generic device config; restore the original device mode for another SIM.
Preserve exact RTP test assertions while waiting for asynchronous forwarding metrics.
limitations: No real SMS/Bot send, cold power-cycle, real network failure, SIM switch or new call test was performed.
Real verification confirms Unicom LTE manual registration; fallback/boot correction covered by mocks.
